preciseBlocker: Publisher confirms original Tables 1 and 2 contain errors; replacements are PDF-only and marked available to purchase. Institution record has metadata but no corrected table. No corrected primary coefficient rows were obtained. No purchase or access-control bypass attempted.
notClaimed: This is a missing verified dataset, not proof that the mathematical model needs a paid API or cannot be implemented. Access to a paper alone is not permission to copy its prose/table artwork.
model: adultHeight = b0 + bHeight*currentHeight + bWeight*currentWeight + bParent*(motherHeight+fatherHeight)/2; age/sex select corrected coefficients. Do not use the sex-adjusted midparent heuristic inside this regression.
scope: Original cohort: 223 white males and 210 white females in Southwest Ohio, disease-free growth applicability; not validated universally. Do not promise an exact final height or use a generic error margin.
neededBeforeNamedMode: Corrected sex/age coefficient rows and their unit convention, verified against 1995 erratum
Age range, exact age-selection/interpolation rule, error-bound convention and out-of-range policy from primary method
Independent spot fixtures at earliest/latest supported ages and both sexes; tests cannot be sourced only from another calculator

safeAlternative.now: Keep the separate, clearly named midparent estimate already implemented.
safeAlternative.optional: User-entered regression coefficients with explicit length/mass unit labels and coefficient source; call it a custom linear height model, not verified Khamis–Roche. No built-in purported KR defaults.

syntheticFixture.meaning: Arithmetic-only invented coefficients, not a biological prediction fixture.
